tour.welcomeTitle: Welcome to the field training platform
tour.welcomeBody: You can apply to opportunities, take the pre-assessment, follow sessions and attendance, submit tasks, take the post-assessment, then receive certificates after requirements are completed and approved.
tour.updateAvailable: Field training workflow was updated. Review the new changes.
tour.doneTitle: You are ready to start field training
tour.doneBody: You can replay the tour anytime from the user guide.

profile.title: Confirm your profile details
profile.body: Review your full name, university, specialty, phone, and email — they are used in reports and official documents.

opportunities.title: Opportunities available to you
opportunities.body: Opportunities appear based on your university, specialty, and registration status. Open a match and review requirements before applying.

application.title: Application and pre-assessment
application.body: After applying, track your request status. Once approved you may need to complete a pre-assessment before training starts.

sessions.title: Sessions and attendance
sessions.body: Follow the session schedule for date, time, and meeting link. When the instructor opens attendance, enter the code within the time window.

tasks.title: Training tasks
tasks.body: Open the task, read instructions, deadline, and grading mode, then upload your work and submit.

submissions.title: How to submit a task
submissions.body: Add a description, upload files, or add a link based on task settings. Submission is complete only after you click submit and see a success message.

progress.title: Track progress and remaining requirements
progress.body: After sessions and tasks, the post-assessment may become available. Track completion and remaining requirements from the training page.

certificates.title: Certificates and documents
certificates.body: Certificates or completion letters appear after requirements and approvals are completed — not automatically after the last session.

admin.title: User guide management
